wallpapers.title: Reading between the lines
wallpapers.caption: Plains zebra foal in Etosha National Park, Namibia
wallpapers.desc: Etosha National Park, Namibia, is not a place for soft starts, and the plains zebra foal in this image seems to get the memo. In a land this vast—nearly 8,600 square miles of salt pans and grassland—timing is everything, and hesitation is expensive. Lions, spotted hyenas, wild dogs, cheetahs, and leopards constantly pressure the herd—especially the youngest—so zebras are born ready. Minutes after arrival, they're upright. Hours later, they're moving.
